label: Figure 10.3: General short-run ATC, AVC and MC diagram
alt: General short-run cost diagram with U-shaped ATC, AVC and MC curves; MC passes through the minimum points of both AVC and ATC.
caption: The standard short-run cost diagram. MC reaches its minimum first, then rises and cuts AVC at the lowest point of AVC and ATC at the lowest point of ATC (marked with dots). ATC lies above AVC and the gap between them (AFC) narrows as output rises.
